description: Answers a plain-English question about Harcourt Valuations' published research on a covered listed mining company: its published NAV per share and price to NAV at the model date, what drives the valuation, or which companies Harcourt covers. It does not value a company at today's prices or at other metal prices. Harcourt builds NAV models asset by asset from each company's own filed technical reports (NI 43-101, S-K 1300, JORC). Answers are written by Klondike Mike, Harcourt's assistant, from Harcourt's published figures, and are not investment advice. Takes one question naming the company. Rate limited per caller per day.

question.description: The question, in plain English, naming the company. For example: "Explain Harcourt's published valuation of Barrick."

title: Ask Klondike Mike about a mining company
